text.title: 忙季过后的椅子
text.situation:
八月，学校集市结束后，米娜把椅子搬回员工桌旁。每个人都付出了很大努力，但小店并没有突然变成迅速兴旺的生意。努尔延长营业时间，只带来小幅销售增加。杰伊提出更务实的改动：保留营业时间，但用清静的最后半小时准备次日维修卡。伊莱四月的投诉让他们更坚持先展示维修结果，再包装。这个小改变彻底改变了杰伊完成订单的方式。米娜把学院老师的一封信放到桌上，那是一封推荐信，介绍杰伊在课程里细致的维修工作。他读了两遍第一句话，然后把信放进包里。

致有关人士：
杰伊五月至七月参加了我们的维修夜课。他细致处理织物和提手，检查完成的工作，并认真接受反馈。我愿意推荐他继续参加实践培训。
A. 帕特尔，作坊课程教师

paragraphs.en: In August, after the school fair, Mina brought the chairs back to the staff table. Everyone had made a tremendous effort, but the shop was not suddenly a booming business. Noor’s longer opening hours had produced only a marginal increase in sales. Jay proposed a more pragmatic change: keep the hours, but use the quiet last half-hour to prepare the next day’s repair cards. Eli’s complaint in April had helped reinforce their habit of showing a repair before wrapping it. That small change had transformed the way Jay finished an order. Mina put a letter from the college tutor on the table. It was a testimonial describing Jay’s careful repair work during the course. He read the first sentence twice, then tucked the letter into his bag.

paragraphs.en:
To whom it may concern,
Jay attended our evening repair course from May to July. He worked carefully with fabric and handles, checked his finished work, and accepted feedback constructively. I would be pleased to recommend him for further practical training.
A. Patel, workshop tutor

S08.Q15.P01.function: The chairs after the busy season
S08.Q15.P01.cue: 说说大家的努力和生意状况。
acceptableAnswers: 每个人都付出很大努力。 小店还不是迅速兴旺的生意。 延长时间只带来小幅销售增长。

S08.Q15.P02.function: The chairs after the busy season
S08.Q15.P02.cue: 说说杰伊的实际改动，以及伊莱的投诉怎样加强了检查习惯。
acceptableAnswers: 杰伊建议务实地调整排班。 伊莱的投诉巩固了他们检查维修的习惯。

S08.Q15.P03.function: The chairs after the busy season
S08.Q15.P03.cue: 说说杰伊的工作变化和老师的信。
acceptableAnswers: 新习惯彻底改变了杰伊完成订单的方式。 老师为杰伊的维修工作写了推荐信。

S08.Q15.T01.function: The chairs after the busy season
S08.Q15.T01.cue: 新安排明显改变了日常工作，怎么说？
acceptableAnswers: 新安排彻底改变了我们的工作方式。
